# OhMyGame attribution

`src/shared/canvas.ts` adapts the three-way `mergeCanvasDocument` implementation from WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame, commit `2cec05e4af5c83d341a02df3462088475685c772`.

Source: https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/blob/2cec05e4af5c83d341a02df3462088475685c772/src/shared/canvas-workspace.ts

Licensed under Apache License 2.0; the unmodified license accompanies this notice. OpenGame changes the document schema, separates layout, rejects both directions of delete/edit conflicts, and validates references after merging. Other canvas implementation files are authored for OpenGame. OhMyGame branding is not used.
